info.title: ROS OCP Backend API
info.description:
GO Echo API for Resource Optimization OCP Backend Service.

**Plugin system:** Endpoints are served by plugins that can be individually enabled or disabled via `ROS_ENABLED_PLUGINS` / `ROS_DISABLED_PLUGINS` environment variables. Disabled plugin routes return `404 Not Found`. Available plugins: `container`, `namespace`, `gpu`, `node`, `pvc`, `snapshot`, `kruize`. Default: all native plugins enabled, kruize disabled. See docs/architecture/plugin-architecture.md for details.

**Term configuration:** Recommendation terms (short/medium/long) control the lookback window for each plugin. Terms can be customized per-tenant via PUT /settings/terms. Administrators can lock terms via environment variables (`ROS_TERMS_<PLUGIN>_<TERM>_WINDOW_DAYS`, `ROS_TERMS_<PLUGIN>_<TERM>_MIN_DATA_DAYS`, `ROS_TERMS_<PLUGIN>_<TERM>_DECAY_HALFLIFE_HOURS`). Locked terms cannot be modified by tenants (PUT returns 422). Maximum window_days varies by plugin: 90 for container/namespace/node/gpu, 365 for pvc.

get.description: Returns GPU time-slicing recommendations aggregated at the node level. Each recommendation suggests a `nvidia.com/gpu.replicas` value that would allow multiple underutilized workloads to share the same physical GPU via NVIDIA time-slicing. This list stays all-hours; nested `business_hours` is only on GET .../gpu/timeslicing/{node}. History and GPU summary `timeslicing.count` also stay all-hours.

Returns aggregate statistics across all container recommendations for the authenticated organization. Provides a high-level overview of fleet health including counts of active, idle, and abandoned containers, total estimated monthly savings, and cluster count. Only considers medium_term cost-engine recommendations.

get.summary: Get node fleet utilization heatmap data
get.description: Returns per-node utilization data for the authenticated organization, designed for rendering a fleet-wide heatmap visualization. Each node includes a server-computed utilization band (idle/low/moderate/healthy/hot) based on the selected metric's p95 value and idle state. Nodes are returned ungrouped; the client groups by `machineset_name`. Requires the `visual-insights` feature to be enabled.

get.summary: Get GPU time-slicing recommendations for one node
get.description: Returns all GPU-model × term time-slicing rows for one node (same row shape as the list). Nested `business_hours` is attached here only when org ⊕ cluster is enabled and every container in the node × GPU model group uses the cluster window. List, history, and GPU summary `timeslicing.count` stay all-hours. Heterogeneous namespace windows omit the nested object. Replica sizing on the nested object emits notification 81 (`GPU_TS_BH_CLUSTER_WINDOW`). Nested BH never includes dollar savings.

Reason-only blocks (insufficient business-hours days) omit code 80. Timeslicing, savings, waste, and explanation are omitted. MIG list and timeslicing list stay all-hours. Timeslicing detail nests TimeslicingBHRecommendation (code 81), not this object.

reason.description: Present when nested sizing is omitted (for example insufficient business-hours days). Code 80 is not emitted on reason-only blocks.

notifications.description: Includes code 80 when nested sizing is present. Not merged into list GPU badges or parent GPU notification arrays.

warnings.description: Optional warnings about degraded data quality (e.g., GPU enrichment failures, scan errors)

count.description: Total number of matching results (before pagination)

notification_codes.description: Notification codes: 36=gpu_time_sharing_candidate. Code 81 is never on this array; it appears only on nested business_hours on GET .../gpu/timeslicing/{node}.

TimeslicingBHRecommendation.description: Nested business-hours GPU time-slicing on GET .../gpu/timeslicing/{node} only. List, history, and summary omit this object. Attached when org ⊕ cluster is enabled and every container in the node × GPU model group uses the cluster window. Heterogeneous namespace windows omit the object. Replica sizing emits notification 81 (GPU_TS_BH_CLUSTER_WINDOW). Reason-only insufficient-data blocks omit 81. Dollar savings are never nested.

reason.description: Present when BH replica sizing is unavailable (insufficient business-hours days or no BH timeslicing rec). Omits code 81.

notifications.description: Includes code 81 when nested replica sizing is present. Not merged into list rows, parent notification_codes, history, or GPU summary.

total_gpus_analyzed.description: Distinct (cluster, node, GPU model) triples in gpu_container_digests for visible clusters

clusters_with_gpu_data.description: Distinct clusters with at least one gpu_container_digests row

link.description: Relative URL path to the strategy listing endpoint

recommended_cpu_cores.description: Recommended CPU cores for the node

recommended_memory_gib.description: Recommended memory in GiB for the node

node_count_reduction.description: Number of nodes that could be consolidated away

estimated_monthly_savings.description: Estimated monthly savings from right-sizing or consolidation

description.description: Human-readable message shown in API notifications map

FleetSummaryResponse.description: Aggregate statistics across all container recommendations for the organization.

total_containers.description: Total number of containers with recommendations (including stale)

active_containers.description: Number of containers with non-stale recommendations

idle_containers.description: Number of containers flagged as idle (CPU < 10mc AND memory < 10 MiB)

abandoned_containers.description: Number of containers classified as zombie (idle_state = 'zombie'; zero CPU AND zero memory usage)

total_monthly_savings.description: Sum of estimated monthly savings across all active (non-stale) recommendations

cluster_count.description: Number of distinct clusters with recommendations

FleetHeatmapResponse.description: Per-node utilization data for fleet heatmap visualization. Nodes include a server-computed utilization band based on the selected metric.

metric.description: Which utilization metric was used for band computation

latest_update.description: Most recent updated_at timestamp across all returned nodes

data_window.description: Human-readable description of the data window for the selected term

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for monetary values in the response. Reflects the user's preferred display currency when exchange rates are available, otherwise falls back to the stored cost model currency.

warnings.description: Optional warnings about result set (e.g., truncation due to node limit)

cluster_alias.description: Human-readable cluster alias from sources, or the cluster UUID if no alias is set

machineset_name.description: MachineSet that owns this node. Empty string if not part of a MachineSet.

instance_type.description: Cloud instance type (e.g. m5.xlarge). Empty string if unknown.

utilization_band.description: Server-computed utilization band based on the selected metric's p95 value and idle state

node_count_reduction.description: Number of nodes that could be consolidated away

usage_bytes_max.description: Maximum observed usage in bytes across all days

usage_ratio.description: Ratio of max usage to capacity (0.0 to 1.0)

recommendation_type.description: Classification: oversized (<20% used), near_full (>85% used), orphaned (0 usage), healthy (normal)

recommended_bytes.description: Recommended PVC size in bytes (null for healthy/orphaned)

days_to_full.description: Projected days until PVC reaches capacity based on growth trend (null if no growth or insufficient data)

growth_bytes_per_day.description: Estimated daily growth in bytes (from linear regression on average usage)

estimated_monthly_savings.description: Estimated monthly savings from right-sizing this PVC. Null when no cost data is available.

data_days.description: Number of days of data available for this PVC

resize_note.description: Operational guidance for acting on the recommendation (e.g., Kubernetes does not support in-place PVC shrinking)

PVCRecommendationListResponse.description: Paginated list of PVC right-sizing recommendations.

count.description: Number of results in this page

NodeBusinessHoursRecommendation.description: Nested business-hours sizing on node detail engines only. List rows omit this object. Notification code 79 (NODE_BH_NOT_PEAK_SAFE) appears only here, never on the parent engine, list row, or top-level detail notifications. Reason-only blocks (insufficient business-hours days) omit code 79.

recommended_cpu_cores.description: Recommended CPU in cores from the business_hours daily_node_digests stream. Omitted when sizing is unavailable.

recommended_memory_gib.description: Recommended memory in GiB from the business_hours stream. Omitted when sizing is unavailable.

reason.description: Present when nested sizing is omitted (for example insufficient business-hours days). Code 79 is not emitted on reason-only blocks.

notifications.description: Includes code 79 when nested sizing is present. Not merged into parent engine notifications.

recommendation_terms.description: Per-term engines. Node detail may nest business_hours on each engine when a cluster-or-org schedule is enabled. List payloads stay all-hours only.

MoneyAmount.description: Structured monetary value with explicit currency. All savings, cost, and waste amounts in the API use this format.

value.description: Decimal amount formatted to two decimal places (e.g., "12.34", "-0.50", "0.00").

units.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Reflects the user's preferred display currency when exchange rates are available, otherwise the cost model's native currency.

XRhIdentity.name: x-rh-identity
XRhIdentity.description: Base64-encoded JSON identity header injected by the platform gateway (3scale, Envoy, or Turnpike). Contains identity.org_id for tenant scoping and entitlements.cost_management.is_entitled for entitlement gating. ROS does not validate JWTs directly; the upstream proxy verifies the token and translates it into this header.
